subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub adopt publisher follows now as a permanent private data model and supported authenticated v1 API for the dependent discovery and notification work?
rationale: The branch introduces new social-product behavior, durable private relationship data, and a public compatibility surface; implementation quality alone cannot establish that product and API commitment.

options.title: Adopt the public follow API
options.body: Approve the proposed private v1 contract, subject to runtime proof, lifecycle coverage, public documentation, and generated-artifact completion.

options.title: Land an internal foundation
options.body: Keep the Convex follow primitives private until the dependent user-facing product direction is validated.

options.title: Pause the follow program
options.body: Defer this branch and its dependent PRs until publisher feeds and notifications receive explicit sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Adopt the public follow API
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed private v1 contract, subject to runtime proof, lifecycle coverage, public documentation, and generated-artifact completion.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent publisher identity and public-API work provides the strongest available routing signal for this product-contract decision.
